(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g)))
    (let ((objs (objects-multicolor g 0)))
      (let ((diag (first (sort-by objs (lambda (o) (- 0 (obj-size o)))))))
        (let ((diag-cells (obj-cells diag)))
          (let ((isolated (filter (lambda (p) (not (for/or ((d diag-cells))
                    (and (= (first d) (first p)) (= (second d) (second p))))))
                  (filter (lambda (p) (not (zero? (at g (first p) (second p)))))
                    (reduce append (list)
                      (map (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range 0 w))) (range 0 h)))))))
            (let* ((n (- (length isolated) 1))
                   (isolated-colors (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) isolated))
                   (color-count (lambda (v) (length (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) v)) isolated))))
                   (first-index (lambda (v)
                     (let ((p (first (filter (lambda (p2) (= (at g (first p2) (second p2)) v)) isolated))))
                       (+ (* (first p) w) (second p)))))
                   (tri-color (first (sort (unique isolated-colors)
                     (lambda (a b)
                       (let ((ca (color-count a)) (cb (color-count b)))
                         (if (= ca cb)
                             (< (first-index a) (first-index b))
                             (> ca cb))))))))
              (let ((corner (find (lambda (p)
                      (or (and (zero? (first p)) (zero? (second p)))
                          (and (zero? (first p)) (= (second p) (- w 1)))
                          (and (= (first p) (- h 1)) (zero? (second p)))
                          (and (= (first p) (- h 1)) (= (second p) (- w 1)))))
                    isolated)))
                (if (not corner) g
                  (let ((cr (first corner)) (cc (second corner)))
                    (let ((base (reduce (lambda (gg d) (set-cell gg (first d) (second d) (at g (first d) (second d))))
                            (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) 0)) diag-cells)))
                      (reduce (lambda (gg i)
                        (let ((num (- n i)))
                          (reduce (lambda (gg2 j)
                            (let ((tr (if (zero? cr) i (- (- h 1) i)))
                                  (tc (if (zero? cc) j (- (- w 1) j))))
                              (set-cell gg2 tr tc tri-color)))
                            gg (range 0 num))))
                        base (range 0 n))))))))))))))
